improvements: The window minimize, maximize, and close buttons now line up with the app's header row instead of sitting in a shorter strip above it.
bugFixes: Fixed direct message conversations still not appearing. Conversations closed under older versions were hidden permanently, and that stored list is now discarded on upgrade so every conversation comes back.

The conversation list can no longer be emptied by hidden-conversation state. If every conversation would be hidden at once, they are shown instead, because an inbox you cannot get out of is never the correct result.
